_comment: Windows payloads that were tested end to end before release. tools/package-windows.ps1 refuses to package a listed version whose files differ, and refuses unlisted payloads unless -AllowUnpinned is given (CI pipeline checks, never released).

1.1.0.tested: Public 1.1.0 build, 2026-11-12: MSVC 14.51, OBS 33.0.1 / Qt 6.11.1, linked with /PDBALTPATH so the DLL names only its PDB file, not the build folder. Full isolated regression and the Windows installer suite passed with exactly these files.
1.1.0.relationship: Same source, compiler and data files as the 1.1.0 DLL that was verified in real use with OBS 33.0.1 and Aitum Multistream (SHA-256 0bc2d22026f7d4c674ca4a2b738b17d73d6a170c90f4b774db92bf1d428b2a07). The two DLLs differ only in the debug-path record and, because that record is shorter, in addresses of read-only data that moved by 0x48/0x50 bytes; code, imports, exports and resources are otherwise identical.
